title: Epitranscriptomic Regulation of PIK3R2 by WTAP/YTHDF3 Axis Drives Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Progression.
snippet: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is an aggressive malignancy with a distinct geographical distribution. Phosphoinositide-3-kinase regulatory subunit 2 (PIK3R2) has been identified as an oncogenic driver in various cancers. However, the role and regulation of PIK3R2 in NPC remain poorly understood.
